### A citation on every question

Each question links to the exact sentence it was drawn from. A server-side check quietly drops anything that doesn't resolve — so “100% cited” is a fact, not a claim.

- ✓ Click any question to trace it to the source

- ✓ Hallucinated references removed automatically

- ✓ Re-checked again the moment it's saved

### A question bank that stays clean

Every accepted question lands in a searchable bank with near-duplicate detection — so a term of material never becomes a term of near-copies.

- ✓ Filter by Bloom's level, type, difficulty

- ✓ Duplicate detection across the whole bank

- ✓ Assemble a paper by blueprint

### Analytics that close the loop

Publish a link, collect attempts, and get quiet, useful psychometrics back — score distribution, per-question difficulty, the items to fix before next term.

- ✓ Server-side scoring, answers never leaked

- ✓ AI-graded written answers, with evidence

- ✓ Export to QTI, Moodle, GIFT and more
